title: Supreme Court quashes criminal case against litigant and lawyer over wrong statements in court pleadings
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday set aside orders directing criminal prosecution of a litigant and his lawyer after lower courts found that they had made wrong statements in court pleadings filed in a civil property dispute [Prabhakar Yeshwant Masram v. Sou Tula Namdeorao Jaipurkar].A Bench of Justices Ujjal Bhuyan and Atul S Chandurkar held that the lower courts had applied the wrong legal standard.
